name: Class Discrimination
overview: Scripture clearly condemns class discrimination by emphasizing that all believers are unified in Christ regardless of social status, as Galatians 3:28 declares there is neither bond nor free in Him. James 2:1 warns against showing partiality, reminding believers to uphold the faith of Jesus without favoritism. Luke 1:53 highlights God's reversal of earthly conditions, filling the hungry while sending the rich away empty, underscoring His sovereign justice. Additionally, Ephesians 4:32 calls Christians to kindness and forgiveness toward one another, reflecting Christ's grace beyond social distinctions.
